name: Toronto Tech Week
description: A decentralized, city-wide week of hundreds of independent community-led tech events across Toronto, drawing founders, operators and investors from dozens of countries. Organizers have confirmed it returns in 2027.

name: Elevate Festival
description: Canada's flagship innovation festival, uniting tech leaders, founders, investors and creatives for three days of keynotes, summits and networking across downtown Toronto.

name: SecTor
audience: security researchers, CISOs, IT security practitioners
description: Canada's largest information security conference, now part of the Black Hat family, featuring briefings, Arsenal tool demos, training and summits on AI, cloud and executive security.

name: FITC Toronto
description: A two-day celebration of design, digital development, media and creative technology, with two tracks of talks and roundtables. The 2026 edition marked FITC's 25th anniversary.

name: MCP Dev Summit Toronto
description: A Linux Foundation developer summit dedicated to the Model Context Protocol and the emerging ecosystem of AI agent tooling and integrations.

name: AWS Summit Toronto
description: Amazon Web Services' free one-day Canadian summit with keynotes, technical breakout sessions, hands-on labs and a partner expo, preceded by a Partner Summit day.

name: Big Data & Analytics Summit Canada

name: Blockchain Futurist Conference

description: Canada's largest and longest-running Web3 event, with three stages, an NFT gallery, ETHWomen programming and an AI Futurist track along the Toronto waterfront.

name: TECHSPO Toronto

description: A two-day technology expo showcasing internet, mobile, adtech, martech and SaaS companies, co-located with the DigiMarCon digital marketing conference.

name: Hack the 6ix
description: Toronto's largest summer student-run hackathon, where 450+ hackers build and pitch a project over 36 hours alongside workshops, panels and mentorship.

name: UofTHacks

name: ElleHacks

name: MakeUofT

name: Canadian Game Awards

name: BearHacks

name: The Big DiF

name: Hack Western

name: MasseyHacks
